features.name: Codex project harness
features.summary: Project-level agent manual, Codex config, command rules, verification scripts, progress log, feature registry, and core docs.

features.name: AI-native canvas workspace
features.summary: AI-native infinite canvas where Agent execution creates durable user-requested outputs without auto-materializing transient tool progress containers, and users arrange, refine, or continue from those results.

features.name: Agent runtime and tool execution
features.summary: Deep Agents/LangChain runtime with streaming, MCP-compatible typed tools, live editor canvas document access, Cucumber structured canvas read/write, page management, layered design/content/refine tools, Figma import, style/variable tools, prompt-to-canvas planning/execution, design-as-code export to React/HTML/Vue, persistence, and workspace skill execution.

features.name: Brand Kit and workspace assets
features.summary: Brand Kit editing, selection, persistence, and generated asset reuse across creative flows.

features.name: Image and video generation
features.summary: Seedream/Volcengine-backed image and video generation through provider adapters, background_jobs state, Supabase task leasing, worker execution, prompt normalization, and direct Cucumber canvas asset insertion.

features.name: Deterministic canvas smoke test
features.summary: Add deterministic e2e smoke tests for canvas editor, import, Agent-output ingestion, persistence, and generated canvas artifacts.

features.name: Cucumber Canvas runtime
features.summary: Cucumber canvas runtime where containers represent Agent output units, spatial layout carries context/data flow, native editing runs on Skia/CanvasKit behind a standalone CanvasApi contract, PenDocument.pages is the only supported durable shape, legacy flat-map/root-children data fails fast, and paste/drag-drop import, edit, and export flows produce editable PenNode trees with explicit degradation warnings.

features.name: Cucumber canvas editor controls
features.summary: Cucumber canvas editor controls with page-aware canvas operations, page tabs, editor toolbar, boolean toolbar, and advanced drawing/editing controls on the live Skia canvas.
features.scope: Multi-page canvas UI, editor toolbar, boolean toolbar, and advanced drawing/editing controls

features.name: Cucumber canvas design system panel
features.summary: Cucumber canvas design-system slice with component creation/instances, document variables and theme axes, and a local icon library rendered through the Skia icon lookup path.
features.scope: Component system, variables/theme panel, and icon library

features.name: Cucumber structured canvas orchestration
features.summary: Prompt-to-canvas planning, live canvas container materialization for requested structured deliverables, structured orchestration logs, and design-as-code export to React, HTML, and Vue.
features.scope: Prompt-to-canvas orchestration MCP tools, section-level concurrent execution, live canvas writes, and Vue codegen export alongside React/HTML.

features.name: Cucumber canvas foundation cleanup
features.summary: Structure cleanup that keeps the deleted local reference tree out of the repo, removes legacy runtime compatibility, makes PenDocument.pages the only supported canvas shape, and documents the next development order: canvas foundation, tools/container types, Agent canvas read/write, then Agent runtime tuning.
features.scope: Canvas and Agent structure cleanup, fail-fast legacy data handling, Cucumber structured canvas tooling, and documentation alignment.

features.name: AI-native canvas collaboration
features.summary: B-stage foundation that makes Agent canvas generation organized, constrained, observable, replayable, and resumable through prompt layering, run-scoped Styleguide injection, AgentTeams roles, model capability profiles, and process stream events.
features.scope: Prompt layers, Styleguide context, model profiles, AgentTeams, run context events, role-aware stage events, and replay spine documentation.
